Class BlindGuard

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.BlindGuard
final class BlindGuard extends Object
Watches for a picture that has no opponent in it although the opponent is right in front of the camera. That is not the agent looking away: it is the picture being wrong, and an agent that is fed it fights blind, and learns from being blind if it is learning.

It goes by where the opponent is, which the picture is never allowed to. A wall between the two looks the same to it, so it is only acted on where there is something to switch off that can cause it: drawing the frame twice to show the player the opponent's own skin.
